facts.summary: MSVC CRT `operator new(size_t)` linked into the game (malloc + _callnewh retry loop, throws bad_alloc / bad_array_new_length). The game's own owner/renderer make-functions allocate with exactly this function, and every delete goes through operator_delete_sized 0x00b49864 -> operator_delete 0x00b495b0 (-> free). The host must allocate the owner with it (not HeapAlloc/malloc of the host CRT).
facts.arm_signature: void* operator_new(size_t size /*r0*/) -> r0 (never returns NULL, throws on OOM); plain AAPCS, no hidden args; callee-saved r4-r11
facts.x86_to_arm_notes: Thumb function: the host MUST call it through a pointer with bit0 set, i.e. (void*)((uintptr_t)image + rva + 1) (a BLX to an even address switches to ARM state and crashes). x86 was cdecl `GameOperatorNewFn(size_t)`; on ARM it is the same shape (r0=size). Typedef: `typedef void *(*GameOperatorNewFn)(size_t);` and the pointer is image+0xb4929c+1. Matching free routines (if the host ever frees): 0x00b495b0 void operator_delete(void*), 0x00b49864 void operator_delete_sized(void*,size_t).

facts.summary: GameOwner constructor (the object that holds the D3D11 device and owns the Renderer; x86 host calls it `game resource owner`). Zero-initialises many members, creates the Renderer via sub_5b8320 (new 0x204 + memset + Renderer::ctor 0x5bb62c), stores it at owner+0xac and writes the owner back-pointer into renderer+0x108. Does NOT touch owner+0xb8/0xbc/0xc0/0xc4.

facts.x86_to_arm_notes: Thumb function: the host MUST call it through a pointer with bit0 set, i.e. (void*)((uintptr_t)image + rva + 1) (a BLX to an even address switches to ARM state and crashes). x86 `thiscall(void*)` -> plain C `void*(*)(void*)`. Sequence the host must reproduce (it mirrors the game's own make_owner at 0x13f2a0): owner = operator_new(0xd0); memset(owner,0,0xd0); owner = ctor(owner); *(uint32_t*)(owner+0xb8)=0x9100; *(uint8_t*)(owner+0xbc)=0; *(void**)(owner+0xc0)=0; *(void**)(owner+0xc4)=0; then publish the pointer in the owner cell. port_instructions: Add THUMB() helper: #define GAME_FN(rva) ((void*)((uintptr_t)image + (rva) + 1)). Use it for owner ctor (0x005b7e7c), InitDevice (0x005bc258), InitTargets (0x005bc0cc), ReleaseTargets (0x005bbb30), operator new (0x00b4929c), and any vtable-derived pointer is already Thumb (bit0 set).

ARM table for initialize_game_d3d (1.2.8/ARM32): operator_new_rva=0x00b4929c, owner_ctor_rva=0x005b7e7c, init_device_rva=0x005bc258, init_targets_rva=0x005bc0cc, release_targets_rva=0x005bbb30, owner_global_rva=0x015b86ac, owner_size=0xd0, owner_renderer_offset=0xac, owner_device_offset=0xc0, renderer_context_offset=0x110, renderer_context2_offset=0x114, renderer_swap_chain_offset=0x104, renderer_rtv_offset=0x118, renderer_dsv_offset=0x120, renderer_backbuffer_offset=0x124 (all offsets except the RVAs are identical to the x86 1.2.8 values).

Owner construction: owner = game_new(0xd0); memset(owner,0,0xd0); owner = owner_ctor(owner); *(uint32_t*)((BYTE*)owner+0xb8) = 0x9100; (+0xbc,+0xc0,+0xc4 stay 0); *(void**)(image+0x015b86ac)=owner. The cell lives in .data (RW) - no VirtualProtect.

Call order is unchanged: owner_ctor -> read renderer=*(owner+0xac) -> init_device(owner, renderer) -> device=*(owner+0xc0), context=*(renderer+0x110) -> create HWND swap chain -> init_targets(owner,&display,renderer) -> store swap chain at renderer+0x104 (Release old, AddRef new) -> read RTV from renderer+0x118 -> install Present hook. InitTargets does not store the swap chain, so keep the explicit store.

Keep the D3D11CreateDevice IAT hook but patch IAT cell 0x00c37a50 (not 0x011d2a44). Keep `flags | 0x20`. Drop the Windows 7 level filtering and captured_base_* logic (host_is_windows7 is never true on ARM). The game retries with WARP by itself.

Present hook: keep vtable slot 8 hook. ADD a slot 22 (Present1) hook with the same sync-interval override, counting game_present_success_count, because the game switches to Present1(0, flags, &params) when [*(u8**)(image+0x015b86b0)+0x30]==0. Also mask DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING (0x200) unless the swap chain supports it. Use PAGE_READWRITE for vtable writes. Consider QueryInterface(IDXGISwapChain1) and store THAT pointer in renderer+0x104 so slot 22 is valid.

Do not call sub_5b9f4c (queryAdapterInfo) or AppPlatform vf143; they are skipped by the game itself when the owner cell is pre-populated (same as x86) and calling queryAdapterInfo would set owner+0x90=1 (tearing) which the host swap chain does not honour.

Display descriptor: keep the same struct (static assert offsetof(swap_chain)==0x1c, sizeof==0x20; stereo @0x19 must stay 0). Optionally also write width/height into renderer+0xe8/+0xec to keep the game's embedded descriptor in sync (not required).

resize_game_window: keep the sequence. release_targets=0x005bbb30, init_targets=0x005bc0cc, backbuffer_offset=0x124, rtv_offset=0x118. Platform/game: app_main+0x1c / +0x20; platform+0x330/+0x334 = width/height; game vtable slot 23 (+0x5c) resize(game,int w,int h,float 0.0f) and slot 24 (+0x60) windowSizeChanged(game,int w,int h) - pass the 4th argument of resize as a float (s0).

patch_win7_discard_views / patch_win7_dxgi_device3_query_to_base: no-ops on ARM (host_is_windows7 false). If ever needed: DiscardWindowViews=0x00582970 (expect 2d e9 18 48 0d f1 08 0b; patch 70 47 00 bf = bx lr), IDXGIDevice3 IID cell=0x00dbc2c4.

game_resource_owner/game_renderer/game_context/game_target/game_swap_chain statics keep their meaning: owner=*(cell), renderer=owner+0xac, context=renderer+0x110, target=renderer+0x118, swap chain host-created and mirrored in renderer+0x104; render_game_target_128's depth view is *(renderer+0x120).

If it never changes the Present1 path is dead, but hooking slot 22 is cheap insurance.

owner+0xbc (u8) meaning and who sets it (0 in make_owner): when non-zero InitDevice adds BGRA flag 0x20 and drops 9_x feature levels. Probably a 'needs D2D/BGRA' or high-end flag; unset in the host path.

Whether the CreateSwapChain (IDXGISwapChain*) pointer on ARM exposes Present1 in the same vtable; recommend QI IDXGISwapChain1 and store that pointer if the Present1 hook is installed. Not testable statically.

Whether the scissor Y bug of install_scissor_fix reproduces on ARM (Renderer::setScissorRect 0x5bb560 uses g_displaySettings+0x14/+0x18 or an object at [renderer-arg+0xe4]); keep the fix, verify at runtime.
